samples.name: packing
samples.label: 行李清单
samples.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate exactly ONE flat front-on high-fidelity Chinese mobile app SCREEN, portrait 390:844 aspect ratio. Full bleed interface, no device frame, no perspective mockup, no surrounding presentation board. This is an art-directed PACKING CHECKLIST for checking actual items packed, not a travel marketing page. Same task and data across six separate style studies: title 行李清单, compact status 未装 4 件, action 编辑. Six items: group 衣物: 换洗上衣 2 件 UNCHECKED, 长裤 1 条 CHECKED; group 电子: 充电宝 1 个 UNCHECKED, 耳机 1 副 CHECKED; group 临走再装: 手机 1 部 UNCHECKED, 充电器 1 个 UNCHECKED. Deferred is NOT completed. End with small inline action ＋ 添加. Keep all six items clearly visible, correct quantities, two checked and four unchecked. Controls softly rounded with visible usable states; Chinese readable at actual phone scale, body around 16-18px, title compact 22-26px, no tiny decorative captions. Quantity aligned meaningfully. Minimal words: only this product's title, state, category labels, item names, quantities and actions. No English eyebrow, slogan, inspirational sentence, fake date, invented metrics, logo, app store badge, navigation tabs, promotional footer, or big generic bottom CTA. Typography must remain clear and purposeful. Do not reduce style to recoloring a standard card stack. Preserve task correctness while making the specified visual grammar shape the composition, material and interaction affordances. Not a poster or six-up collage.
DIRECTION: sophisticated playful flat illustration mobile utility. Warm clean white background, tomato-red actions, cobalt and butter-yellow image accents, firm consistent dark ink outlines and genuinely rounded controls. Organize checklist as two clearly shaped packing zones: compact side-by-side 衣物 and 电子 open sections in upper-middle, each containing two real item rows; full-width pale-yellow 临走再装 tray below with its two rows. A small bespoke flat illustration of folded shirt integrated into clothes heading and a power bank into electronics heading, not a big mascot or generic emoji. Illustrations have distinctive silhouettes, premium editorial drawing, controlled scale. Large readable item names even in two zones, quantities on second line if needed. Strong composition and tactile selection states, no huge illustration hero, no grid of identical white cards. Total six items remain clear. The design can be cheerful without childish clutter.

samples.name: dinner
samples.label: 晚餐搭配
samples.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally art-directed, polished Chinese mobile small-tool SCREEN for a public GitHub README showcase. Portrait 390:844 ratio, full bleed, flat front-on, no phone bezel, no perspective device staging, no surrounding presentation. This must look like a working consumer tool at actual phone scale, NOT a marketing landing page or social poster. A compact meaningful title, REAL useful UI controls and concise Chinese only. Realistic 16-18px reference body text, comfortable touch targets, soft rounded action controls, carefully composed hierarchy and whitespace. Minimize copy: no slogans, English eyebrows, redundant explanatory captions, ornamental numbers, fake testimonials, brand logos, tab bar unless genuinely essential, confetti, generic sparkles, repetitive nested cards or giant fixed CTA. Do not fill space with instructions. Use distinct typography, composition and assets specific to the task. Only render the exact concise labels needed below; no gratuitous text. Crisp readable Chinese. Focus on balanced composition and finished details, not decorative excess.
A vivid sophisticated hand-painted market menu planner RESULT, a useful DINNER RECOMMENDATION TOOL. Compact heading 今晚吃什么. Top controls 两人 / 预算 ¥50. Central art-directed plate arrangement with exquisite editorial watercolor food illustrations: tomato eggs, stirfried greens, tofu soup, rice. A clean aligned menu list integrated directly below, not each item in a card: 番茄炒蛋 ¥19; 清炒时蔬 ¥12; 豆腐汤 ¥10; 米饭 ¥7. Bottom of menu total 合计 ¥48 and 人均 ¥24, accurate math, not huge dashboard metric cards. Two rounded quiet actions 换一份 and 调整预算 near menu bottom. White ceramic tabletop tone, tomato red and fresh green accents, brushed ultramarine ink detail, unified fine watercolor art. The plate composition is a meaningful preview not a generic hero. Clear body Chinese, quantities and prices aligned. High-end food illustration with useful product UI, not a recipe poster, no redundant title paragraph.
